themes: Humility and caring for every person
summary_for_children: 'Abasa reminds us to care for everyone who seeks guidance and asks us to look at our food: water, earth, grain, grapes, olives and fruit.
environment_concept: A walk that follows food from the start: a torrent of water pouring down rocks (80:25), earth split open by sprouts (80:26), rows of grain and grapevines on a trellis (80:27-28), olive and palm trees (80:29), and fruit trees over grass (80:31). The event of 80:1-10 and the Day of 80:33-42 are not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A rocky waterfall and stream, cracked earth with sprouts, grain rows and a vine trellis, olive and palm trees, fruit trees.

unique_world.visual_theme: A river valley after heavy rain with a field ready to plough, a hand plough at its edge, and olives and palms along the banks

primary_mechanic.text: Plough five furrows by walking from the gold-flagged stake to the far stake, each furrow starting where the last ended; if you wander more than a metre off the line the furrow must be started again. When all are ploughed the foods of 80:27-31 come up along them (80:24-26, water poured, the earth split).

secondary_activities: he frowned (80:1-4, read; the Prophet and the blind man are not shown)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading on the valley path, ploughing the field, then a reading by the fence
environment_behaviour: crops come up along the furrows once all are ploughed
unique_world.learning_objective: Look at our food and where it comes from (80:24-32)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: Everyone Deserves Respect
story_library.children_narration: Surah 'Abasa recalls an incident involving a blind man who sincerely sought guidance. The revelation teaches an important lesson about giving proper attention and respect to people, regardless of their position or abilities. It also invites us to look at food and how plants grow.

world_idea.title: The School of Respect
world_idea.description: Explore an inclusive learning environment with activities designed around different accessibility needs. A second zone investigates the journey from rain to growing crops. ## Part 5 — Surahs 81–100

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
story_library.rule_conflicts_resolved: The Prophet and the blind man are not shown. The event is narration with its source labelled.
